issues.title: FastAPI intermittent startup hang
issues.description: uvicorn accepts TCP but never responds to HTTP. create_app() synchronous initialization can deadlock.
issues.root_cause: Synchronous startup path (spaCy+DB+services) can block before first request. No startup logging. No stale-process cleanup.
fix_options: Kill stale processes on run.bat startup
Add startup health gate with timeout

issues.title: 8 research endpoints broken — missing imports
issues.page: Research Data, Research Evidence, Research Overview
issues.description: ResearchDataService, ExportJob, HumanReviewCreate used in main.py but never imported. All return HTTP 500.
issues.root_cause: Missing import statements at top of app/api/main.py
fix_options: Add missing imports: from app.research.service import ResearchDataService; from app.research.schemas import ExportJob, HumanReviewCreate

issues.title: Generic API-unavailable error for all request failures
issues.description: Single error message for connection refused, timeout, DNS failure. 90s timeout before message appears. Does not suggest checking running processes.
issues.root_cause: ApiClient._request() catches all RequestException with one message
fix_options: Classify errors: ConnectionError vs Timeout vs HTTPError
Add health-check before showing run.bat message

issues.title: 90-second API client timeout with no intermediate feedback
issues.description: ApiClient default timeout is 90s. No progress indicator or early failure detection.

issues.title: Learning Journey always empty — no practice data
issues.description: Zero engagement traces for all students. Empty message says Submit an essay but S02 has 6 essays.
issues.root_cause: No practice targets/engagement traces seeded in demo database
fix_options: Seed demo data with engagement traces
Fix empty-state message to reflect existing essays
Generate practice targets on essay submission

issues.title: Generic 500 handler hides all internal errors
issues.description: Exception handler returns identical message for NameError, DB errors, logic bugs. No logs.
issues.root_cause: @api.exception_handler(Exception) returns generic message with no logging
fix_options: Add logging of exception type and traceback

issues.title: No automatic recovery after API restart
issues.description: Streamlit does not detect API recovery. Manual navigation or refresh required.
issues.root_cause: Streamlit API client has no health-polling or retry-on-recovery logic

issues.title: Two-step interaction pattern not communicated
issues.description: Enter ID triggers rerun to show Load button. No indication button will appear.
issues.root_cause: st.button inside conditional (if not student_id.strip(): return) prevents button rendering until after rerun
fix_options: Always show button but disable until ID entered
Show hint text after ID entry

issues.title: Student ID not shared across Student View pages
issues.description: S02 must be re-entered on every page navigation. Each page has own input key.
issues.root_cause: Each page uses unique st.text_input key
fix_options: Add global student selector in sidebar

issues.title: Empty Journey message contradicts existing essay data
issues.description: S02 has 6 essays but Journey says Submit an essay with feedback first
issues.root_cause: Empty state message does not check essay count
fix_options: Customize message when essays exist but no traces

issues.title: Mobile sidebar requires hamburger toggle
issues.description: Radio labels unreachable without expanding sidebar. Streamlit framework limitation.

issues.title: No loading progress during API calls
issues.description: st.spinner used on Writing submission only. Data-fetching pages show blank during API calls.
issues.root_cause: No spinner on get_engagement_traces, get_practice_targets, etc.

issues.title: Research Overview shows analyzer version as aggregate count
issues.description: spacy shown as a count metric alongside spacy-analyzer-v0.8.0 — confusing
issues.root_cause: Card layout uses health values as counts
fix_options: Redesign Overview cards for system status not counts

issues.title: Error details may not be fully localized
issues.description: api_unavailable key exists but exception details are English-only
fix_options: Map error types to locale keys

issues.title: Deploy button visible in sidebar
issues.description: Streamlit default Deploy button appears. Not relevant for local prototype.

issues.title: Monospace font may reduce readability
issues.description: Full monospace stack for body text. Some users may find fatiguing.
fix_options: Consider proportional font for body text

issues.title: Button 1px border limitation
issues.description: Streamlit primary button retains 1px border. Documented in KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md.

issues.title: Radio page nav triggers full rerun
issues.description: Clicking page radio triggers full page rerun. Standard Streamlit behavior.
fix_options: Consider st.navigation in newer Streamlit versions
